commands.desc: EMERGENCY: kill node.exe, 7z.exe to free RAM
commands.script: Get-Process node,7z -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'node+7z killed'

commands.desc: EMERGENCY: kill non-essential SYSTEM powershell (keep current session)
commands.script: Get-Process powershell -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.SI -eq 0 } | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'SYSTEM ps killed'

commands.desc: EMERGENCY: temporarily disable Claude scheduled tasks to free RAM
commands.script: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like '*Claude*' -or $_.TaskName -like '*claude*' -or $_.TaskName -like '*DC*' -or $_.TaskName -like '*Watchdog*' -or $_.TaskName -like '*Poller*' -or $_.TaskName -like '*Relay*' } | Disable-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Claude tasks paused'

commands.desc: EMERGENCY: kill Stellaris and other heavy processes if running
commands.script: 'stellaris','stellaris_launcher','EasyAntiCheat','steamwebhelper' | ForEach-Object { Get-Process $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force }; [System.GC]::Collect(); Write-Host 'misc heavy procs killed'

note: EMERGENCY batch — laptop frozen, can't run PS or Task Manager. Kill node/7z/Stellaris, pause Claude tasks.
